text:
Dina R.: Heads up 11 final run-of-show for Friday's 'Benchmarks & Serving' webinar. Need to lock recording destination, transcript handling, and replay gating.

Noah L.: Quick wins: Use Zoom cloud recording + auto-transcript. Push the MP4 + VTT into our S3 bucket 'redwood-marketing/webinars/2026/benchmarks'. From there, CMS ingest to host the gated replay.

Dina R.: S3 lifecycle note: objects under /webinars/2026/benchmarks/ should have 'glacier' policy after 90 days? Check with infra but we need 1 year of retention for compliance.

zoom-bot: Cloud recording will be available under host account. Transcripts (VTT) generated within ~20 minutes.

Priya S.: I'm ok with S3 as master store. But for gated replay UX, Wistia gives better analytics and easier embed. Proposed flow: Zoom -> S3 (master) -> Wistia import via API -> gated embed page on site (HubSpot landing page). Wistia webhook posts view events to Segment.

Maya B.: Lead routing details: HubSpot registration form must include hidden fields: webinar_id=benchmarks_2026_04_02, utm_campaign=benchmarks_launch_q2. Add checkbox for "share email with partners" but unchecked by default.

Noah L.: Engagement scoring rules (proposal):
- Registered: +5
- Attended live: +30
- Watched replay >= 50%: +20
- Downloaded slides: +10
- Requested follow-up/demo: +50
Use property name: webinar_benchmarks_score (integer).

Priya S.: For the replay email series:
- 15 min: immediate replay link + 90s highlight clip (ungated)
- 36 hours: technical deep-dive clip + CTA to request benchmark report (gated)
- 5 days: product-focused email tailored by 'content_preference' hidden field
- 12 days: success story + closed-loop CTA to demo

Dina R.: Recording consent: set Zoom meeting option to show consent prompt on join. Also enable auto-delete = OFF. Add alt host @noah and co-host @priya.

zoom-bot: Alternative host assigned: Noah L.; co-hosts: Priya S.. Consent option: ON.

Maya B.: Integration notes: Wistia -> Segment -> HubSpot mapping: event names: webinar_replay_start, webinar_replay_progress_25/50/75/100, webinar_clip_play. Map these to custom behavioral events in HubSpot via Segment.

Noah L.: Action items:
- Priya: set up Wistia project + API key + webhook endpoint (priority)
- Maya: build HubSpot form + hidden fields + list/automation
- Dina: schedule dry run and confirm S3 write permissions + retention policy
- Noah: draft replay email templates + social distribution plan

Priya S.: I'll knock out the Wistia config today. Also will create a small FFmpeg script to burn captions and produce the 90s highlight. Example:
```
# 90s highlight (first 90s)
ffmpeg -i zoom_master.mp4 -ss 00:00:00 -to 00:01:30 -c:v libx264 -crf 22 highlight90.mp4
# burn in captions
ffmpeg -i highlight90.mp4 -i transcript.vtt -c:v libx264 -c:a copy -vf subtitles=transcript.vtt highlight90_subs.mp4
```

Dina R.: Confirmed: dry run Thursday 3pm PT. Please join. Also set a backup recording host if presenter connection drops.

Maya B.: One more: track replay clicks from social posts with UTM and add workflow: if social click -> add to list 'Benchmarks - Social Clicks' -> send nurture 7 days later.

Noah L.: I'll coordinate CTA text for social posts. Use hero quote and a short stat from the benchmark to drive clicks.

Dina R.: Ownership recap: Priya -> Wistia + clips. Maya -> HubSpot + list/workflows. Noah -> social + email copy. Dina -> dry run + Zoom settings + S3 handoff. We'll reconvene after the dry run to confirm everything. :rocket:

zoom-bot: Reminder set for dry run (2026-04-01 15:00).
